description: Cities of 500,000+ ranked by how much nicer their weather is than their cost of living predicts (value), with a 0–100 nice-weather score and cost of living (US = 100). Quadrants: sweet (fine weather, affordable), pricey, tough (cheap, harder climate), other. Countries under a US 'do not travel' advisory are left out.
name: weather_for_the_money
title: Best weather for the money
